svg.aria-label: Full KDL benchmark results: MB/s per library and input
svg.text: MB/s, higher is better (parsing: of input; writing: of output) · bold = best in its group · shading = relative to that best (log scale)
Each value is the median of 3 processes · FAIL = parse error or wrong node count · DNF = did not finish within 60 s · — = no writer · * see the notes under the chart
